description: M6 提示词工作台内置知识库：模型档案、13 个内容维度、标准词条、场景模板与互斥词表。属于版本化产品配置，升级时以稳定 id 合并。

profiles.label: 通用
profiles.description: 无法识别目标模型时使用，输出清晰、无冲突的中文自然语言描述，不输出权重与负向语法
profiles.structure_hint: 主体描述，动作与状态，环境与光线，整体风格与画质

profiles.label: SD1.5 / SDXL
profiles.description: 英文短语与标签，英文逗号分隔，支持权重语法与负向提示词
profiles.structure_hint: 主体与外观, 材质, 动作, 环境, 构图, 镜头, 光线, 色彩, 风格, 质量

profiles.label: FLUX / FLUX.2
profiles.description: 自然语言描述，重要元素靠前，不生成负向提示词
profiles.structure_hint: 主体 + 动作 + 风格 + 上下文

dimensions.label: 主体
dimensions.description: 画面核心对象：人物、动物、器物、建筑等

dimensions.label: 外观/材质
dimensions.description: 主体的材质、肌理与表面表现

dimensions.label: 动作/姿态
dimensions.description: 主体的动作、姿势与动态趋势

dimensions.label: 环境
dimensions.description: 场景、空间与背景氛围载体

dimensions.label: 构图
dimensions.description: 画面组织方式、留白与视觉引导

dimensions.label: 镜头
dimensions.description: 景别、焦距、机位与景深控制

dimensions.label: 色彩
dimensions.description: 色调、配色关系与调色倾向

dimensions.label: 艺术风格
dimensions.description: 写实、插画、流派等整体视觉风格

dimensions.label: 质量
dimensions.description: 清晰度、细节、渲染与后期质量要求

dimensions.label: 文字排版
dimensions.description: 标题、字体与版式；仅在用户明确要求文字时补充

dimensions.label: 负向约束
dimensions.description: 仅用于生成负向提示词，不进入正向提示词

terms.name: 女性肖像

flux_flux2.text: A woman is the clear subject, framed as a portrait
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面主体是一位女性，以肖像方式呈现

terms.note: 最通用的人物主体写法，适合放在提示词开头
terms.example: portrait of a woman, soft window light, 85mm lens

terms.name: 男性肖像

flux_flux2.text: A man is the clear subject, framed as a portrait
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面主体是一位男性，以肖像方式呈现

terms.note: 与女性肖像对称的通用主体写法
terms.example: portrait of a man, hard light, low angle shot

terms.name: 全身人物
terms.text: full body shot of a person

flux_flux2.text: A person is shown from head to toe in full body
flux_flux2.text_zh: 人物从头到脚完整入镜的全身画面

terms.note: 强调完整身形，适合服装与姿态展示
terms.example: full body shot of a person, standing, relaxed posture

terms.name: 少女

flux_flux2.text: A young girl stands at the center of the scene
flux_flux2.text_zh: 一名少女站在画面中央

terms.note: 青春感主体，常与校园、日常场景搭配
terms.example: a young girl, walking forward, misty forest at dawn

terms.name: 长者

flux_flux2.text: An elderly person with a face marked by time
flux_flux2.text_zh: 一位脸上写满岁月痕迹的长者

terms.note: 强调岁月痕迹，搭配细节皮肤质感效果更好
terms.example: an elderly person, detailed skin texture, warm window light

terms.name: 猫

flux_flux2.text: A cat sits calmly at the center of the frame
flux_flux2.text_zh: 一只猫安静地待在画面中央

terms.note: 动物类高频主体，配合浅景深表现毛发
terms.example: a cat, macro photography, soft window light

terms.name: 飞鸟

flux_flux2.text: A bird is captured mid-flight with its wings spread
flux_flux2.text_zh: 一只鸟在展翅飞翔的瞬间被定格

terms.note: 动态主体，需要锐利对焦与高速快门描述
terms.example: a bird in flight, sharp focus, telephoto lens compression

terms.name: 仿生机器人

flux_flux2.text: A humanoid robot stands facing the camera
flux_flux2.text_zh: 一个仿生机器人正面朝向镜头站立

terms.note: 科幻主体，常与冷色调、未来城市搭配
terms.example: a humanoid robot, brushed metal surface, futuristic city skyline

terms.name: 跑车

flux_flux2.text: A sleek sports car is parked as the clear subject
flux_flux2.text_zh: 一辆线条流畅的跑车作为画面主体停放着

terms.note: 车类主体，低机位与硬光更能表现体量
terms.example: a sports car, low angle shot, golden hour sunlight

terms.name: 手工料理

flux_flux2.text: A freshly plated handmade dish is the focus of the image
flux_flux2.text_zh: 一份刚装盘的手工料理是整张图的焦点

terms.note: 美食主体，俯拍与自然窗光最稳
terms.example: a handmade dish, overhead shot, soft window light

terms.name: 丝绸材质
terms.text_zh: 顺滑有光泽的丝绸材质

flux_flux2.text: The silk fabric catches a smooth, flowing sheen
flux_flux2.text_zh: 丝绸面料泛着顺滑流动的光泽

terms.note: 表现柔顺反光，适合服装与静物
terms.example: silk fabric with smooth sheen, rim lighting

terms.name: 拉丝金属

flux_flux2.text: The brushed metal has a fine directional grain
flux_flux2.text_zh: 拉丝金属表面带有细腻的方向性纹理

terms.note: 工业质感，配合侧光表现纹理方向
terms.example: brushed metal surface, hard light, macro photography

terms.name: 半透明玻璃

flux_flux2.text: Translucent glass softly bends the light passing through it
flux_flux2.text_zh: 半透明的玻璃把穿透的光线柔和地折射开

terms.note: 需要逆光或轮廓光才能体现通透感
terms.example: translucent glass, backlit with glowing edges

terms.name: 做旧皮革
terms.text_zh: 带有使用痕迹的做旧皮革

flux_flux2.text: The leather looks worn, with creases that suggest long use
flux_flux2.text_zh: 皮革看起来很旧，折痕显示出长期使用

terms.note: 复古与硬朗气质的常用材质
terms.example: worn leather texture, warm candlelight, macro photography

terms.name: 木纹

flux_flux2.text: Natural wood grain runs across the whole surface
flux_flux2.text_zh: 自然的木纹贯穿整个表面

terms.note: 室内与家具场景的高频材质
terms.example: natural wood grain, soft daylight, wide angle lens

terms.name: 皮肤质感
terms.text_zh: 细节丰富的皮肤质感，可见毛孔

flux_flux2.text: The skin shows fine, realistic pores and subtle texture
flux_flux2.text_zh: 皮肤上有细腻真实的毛孔与微妙质感

terms.note: 写实人像关键细节，动漫风格应避免使用
terms.example: detailed skin texture, sharp focus, soft window light

terms.name: 发丝细节

flux_flux2.text: Individual strands of hair are clearly visible
flux_flux2.text_zh: 每一根发丝都清晰可见

terms.note: 提升人像精致度，配合轮廓光效果最佳
terms.example: individual hair strands, rim lighting, backlit

terms.name: 陶瓷釉面

flux_flux2.text: The glazed ceramic reflects light in a smooth, even highlight
flux_flux2.text_zh: 上釉的陶瓷表面反射出均匀柔和的高光

terms.note: 产品摄影常用，需要干净的高光过渡
terms.example: glazed ceramic surface, studio lighting, seamless background

terms.name: 天鹅绒

flux_flux2.text: Soft velvet absorbs the light and leaves a gentle sheen
flux_flux2.text_zh: 柔软的天鹅绒吸光，只留下温润的光泽

terms.note: 吸光材质，适合表现低调奢华氛围
terms.example: soft velvet texture, warm candlelight, moody lighting

terms.name: 锈蚀做旧

flux_flux2.text: The surface is weathered and rusted, marked by time
flux_flux2.text_zh: 表面被风化和锈蚀，布满时间的痕迹

terms.note: 废墟与赛博朋克场景的常用材质
terms.example: weathered rusted surface, overcast light, desaturated palette

terms.name: 自然站立

flux_flux2.text: The subject stands in a relaxed, natural posture
flux_flux2.text_zh: 主体以放松自然的站姿站立

terms.note: 基础静态姿态，不会引入额外叙事
terms.example: portrait of a woman, standing, relaxed posture

terms.name: 向前行走

flux_flux2.text: The subject is walking forward through the scene
flux_flux2.text_zh: 主体正向前穿过整个场景

terms.note: 温和的动态，适合环境人像
terms.example: walking forward, narrow neon-lit alley, low angle shot

terms.name: 转身回望
terms.text: turning back to look over the shoulder

flux_flux2.text: The subject turns back and looks over one shoulder
flux_flux2.text_zh: 主体回过身，从肩膀上方看向镜头

terms.note: 经典人像动作，能建立与观众的眼神联系
terms.example: turning back to look over the shoulder, rim lighting

terms.name: 盘腿而坐

flux_flux2.text: The subject sits cross-legged and faces the camera
flux_flux2.text_zh: 主体盘腿坐着，正面朝向镜头

terms.note: 室内与 relaxed 风格常用姿态
terms.example: sitting cross-legged, cozy interior with warm light

terms.name: 全力奔跑

flux_flux2.text: The subject runs at full speed with the body fully extended
flux_flux2.text_zh: 主体全速奔跑，身体完全舒展开

terms.note: 强动态，需要配合清晰边缘避免糊成一团
terms.example: running at full speed, sharp focus, open snow field

terms.name: 伸出手

flux_flux2.text: The subject reaches out with one hand toward the camera
flux_flux2.text_zh: 主体伸出一只手，朝向镜头的方向

terms.note: 增强互动感，注意手部结构需写进负向提示词
terms.example: reaching out with one hand, shallow depth of field

terms.name: 发丝飘动

flux_flux2.text: Hair blows freely in the wind
flux_flux2.text_zh: 发丝在风中自由地飘动

terms.note: 为静态人像加入自然动势
terms.example: hair blowing in the wind, windswept mountain ridge

terms.name: 旋转

flux_flux2.text: The subject spins, and the dress flares out around them
flux_flux2.text_zh: 主体旋转起来，裙摆在身旁散开

terms.note: 强叙事动作，只在高强度扩写时建议
terms.example: spinning with the dress flaring, open snow field

terms.name: 手持物件
terms.text: holding an object in both hands

flux_flux2.text: The subject holds an object carefully in both hands
flux_flux2.text_zh: 主体用双手小心地捧着一件物件

terms.note: 产品与人像结合时的桥梁动作
terms.example: holding an object in both hands, product photography

terms.name: 倚靠

flux_flux2.text: The subject leans casually against a wall
flux_flux2.text_zh: 主体随意地倚靠在墙边

terms.note: 街拍常用姿态，轻松且不失结构
terms.example: leaning against a wall, narrow neon-lit alley

terms.name: 雨夜街道
terms.text: rainy street at night with wet reflections
terms.text_zh: 雨夜的街道，地面有积水倒影

flux_flux2.text: The scene is set on a rainy street at night, with wet reflections on the ground
flux_flux2.text_zh: 场景发生在雨夜的街道上，地面满是积水的倒影

terms.note: 赛博朋克与都市叙事的标配环境
terms.example: rainy street at night, colored neon glow, low angle shot

terms.name: 晨雾森林

flux_flux2.text: A forest at dawn is wrapped in thin morning mist
flux_flux2.text_zh: 黎明时分的森林被薄薄的晨雾笼罩

terms.note: 柔和散射光，适合宁静氛围
terms.example: misty forest at dawn, volumetric light rays

terms.name: 沙漠黄昏

flux_flux2.text: Desert dunes stretch out under a wide dusk sky
flux_flux2.text_zh: 沙丘在广阔的黄昏天空下延展开来

terms.note: 空旷环境，适合孤独与史诗氛围
terms.example: desert dunes at dusk, golden hour sunlight, wide shot

terms.name: 温暖室内

flux_flux2.text: The interior feels cozy, lit by warm and comfortable light
flux_flux2.text_zh: 室内空间温暖舒适，被柔和的暖光照亮

terms.note: 生活化场景，适合治愈向内容
terms.example: cozy interior with warm light, soft window light

terms.name: 霓虹小巷

flux_flux2.text: A narrow alley glows with colored neon light
flux_flux2.text_zh: 一条狭窄的小巷被彩色霓虹灯照亮

terms.note: 高对比色彩环境，与青橙调色契合
terms.example: narrow neon-lit alley, teal and orange color grading

terms.name: 山脊

flux_flux2.text: A windswept mountain ridge opens up behind the subject
flux_flux2.text_zh: 狂风掠过的山脊在主体身后展开

terms.note: 大场景环境，需要广角才能体现气势
terms.example: windswept mountain ridge, wide angle lens, epic atmosphere

terms.name: 海边悬崖

flux_flux2.text: The scene sits on a rocky cliff high above the sea
flux_flux2.text_zh: 场景位于海面之上高高的岩石悬崖边

terms.note: 开阔海景，注意地平线位置
terms.example: rocky cliff above the sea, golden hour sunlight

terms.name: 旧图书馆
terms.text_zh: 摆满高书架的旧图书馆

flux_flux2.text: An old library is lined with tall shelves of worn books
flux_flux2.text_zh: 一间旧图书馆里排满了放旧书的高书架

terms.note: 强叙事环境，与怀旧氛围天然匹配
terms.example: old library with tall bookshelves, warm candlelight

terms.name: 雪原

flux_flux2.text: An open field of untouched snow surrounds the subject
flux_flux2.text_zh: 一片无人踏过的开阔雪原环绕着主体

terms.note: 高反光环境，注意曝光不要溢出
terms.example: open snow field, cold moonlight, wide shot

terms.name: 未来城市

flux_flux2.text: A futuristic city skyline rises in the distance
flux_flux2.text_zh: 未来感的城市天际线在远处升起

terms.note: 科幻大背景，与冷色调和体积光搭配
terms.example: futuristic city skyline, volumetric light rays, cool color tone

terms.name: 三分法构图
terms.text_zh: 主体位于三分线交点的构图

flux_flux2.text: The subject sits on a rule-of-thirds intersection, which keeps the frame balanced
flux_flux2.text_zh: 主体位于三分线的交点上，画面因此保持平衡

terms.note: 最安全通用的构图规则
terms.example: rule of thirds composition, rocky cliff above the sea

terms.name: 中心对称构图

flux_flux2.text: The composition is centered and symmetrical
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面采用居中且对称的构图

terms.note: 庄重稳定，适合建筑与产品
terms.example: centered symmetrical composition, futuristic city skyline

terms.name: 引导线构图
terms.text: strong leading lines toward the subject
terms.text_zh: 有力的引导线指向主体

flux_flux2.text: Strong leading lines draw the eye straight to the subject
flux_flux2.text_zh: 有力的引导线把视线直接引向主体

terms.note: 街道、走廊、栏杆天然提供引导线
terms.example: strong leading lines, narrow neon-lit alley

terms.name: 前景框景
terms.text_zh: 利用前景元素形成框景

flux_flux2.text: Foreground elements frame the subject like a natural border
flux_flux2.text_zh: 前景元素像天然画框一样把主体框住

terms.note: 增加纵深层次，适合林间与街景
terms.example: framed by foreground elements, misty forest at dawn

terms.name: 大面积留白

flux_flux2.text: Generous negative space surrounds the subject and keeps the frame calm
flux_flux2.text_zh: 主体周围留出大面积空白，画面因此安静下来

terms.note: 海报与极简设计的重要手法
terms.example: generous negative space, minimalist style

terms.name: 前中后景层次
terms.text_zh: 前景、中景与背景层次分明

flux_flux2.text: The frame is layered into a clear foreground, midground and background
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面被清晰地分为前景、中景和背景三层

terms.note: 提升空间纵深感，适合大场景
terms.example: layered depth, windswept mountain ridge, wide angle lens

terms.name: 俯视平铺
terms.text: flat lay shot from directly above
terms.text_zh: 正上方俯拍的平铺构图

flux_flux2.text: The objects are arranged in a flat lay shot from directly above
flux_flux2.text_zh: 物件被平铺摆放，由正上方俯拍

terms.note: 美食、文具与产品清单的经典呈现
terms.example: flat lay from directly above, natural wood grain

terms.name: 倾斜构图

flux_flux2.text: The camera tilts slightly, giving the frame a dutch angle
flux_flux2.text_zh: 镜头微微倾斜，让画面带上倾斜构图

terms.note: 制造不安定感，适合悬疑与动作场景
terms.example: dutch angle composition, tense suspenseful atmosphere

terms.name: 满版特写

flux_flux2.text: The subject fills the frame with almost no empty space
flux_flux2.text_zh: 主体几乎填满整个画面，不留空隙

terms.note: 强化情绪冲击，压缩环境信息
terms.example: subject fills the frame, detailed skin texture

terms.name: 黄金螺旋构图
terms.text_zh: 沿黄金螺旋展开的构图

flux_flux2.text: The composition follows a golden spiral that leads to the subject
flux_flux2.text_zh: 构图沿着黄金螺旋展开，最终收束到主体

terms.note: 比三分法更柔和的视觉引导
terms.example: golden spiral composition, a handmade dish

terms.name: 85mm 人像镜头

flux_flux2.text: The shot is taken with an 85mm portrait lens
flux_flux2.text_zh: 这张照片使用 85mm 人像镜头拍摄

terms.note: 人像焦段，面部透视自然不夸张
terms.example: 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field

terms.name: 24mm 广角

flux_flux2.text: A 24mm wide angle lens widens the sense of space
flux_flux2.text_zh: 24mm 广角镜头把空间感进一步拉开

terms.note: 强调环境，注意边缘畸变
terms.example: 24mm wide angle lens, futuristic city skyline

terms.name: 微距

flux_flux2.text: The camera moves in for a macro shot of the finest detail
flux_flux2.text_zh: 镜头推到极近，用微距捕捉最细微的细节

terms.note: 材质与产品的细节表现手段
terms.example: macro photography, glazed ceramic surface

terms.name: 浅景深

flux_flux2.text: The image uses a shallow depth of field that keeps only the subject sharp
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面使用浅景深，只让主体保持清晰

terms.note: 最有效的主体突出手段
terms.example: shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh background

terms.name: 长曝光

flux_flux2.text: The scene is captured with a long exposure that smooths motion
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面使用长曝光拍摄，运动被柔化

terms.note: 表现水流、车轨与云雾流动
terms.example: long exposure, rocky cliff above the sea

terms.name: 低机位仰拍

flux_flux2.text: The camera shoots from a low angle looking up
flux_flux2.text_zh: 镜头从低处向上仰拍

terms.note: 强化主体气势，适合建筑与英雄镜头
terms.example: low angle shot, futuristic city skyline

terms.name: 正上方俯拍

flux_flux2.text: The camera looks straight down from overhead
flux_flux2.text_zh: 镜头从正上方垂直向下拍摄

terms.note: 美食与桌面静物的常用机位
terms.example: overhead shot, a handmade dish

terms.name: 长焦压缩

flux_flux2.text: A telephoto lens compresses the background behind the subject
flux_flux2.text_zh: 长焦镜头把主体背后的背景压缩在一起

terms.note: 让远景更贴近主体，压缩空间层次
terms.example: telephoto compression, a bird in flight

terms.name: 散景虚化

flux_flux2.text: The background melts into creamy bokeh
flux_flux2.text_zh: 背景融化成柔和油润的散景

terms.note: 夜景与灯光的加分项
terms.example: creamy bokeh background, narrow neon-lit alley

terms.name: 手持纪实
terms.text_zh: 手持拍摄的纪实感构图

flux_flux2.text: The framing feels handheld and documentary in style
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面构图带有手持拍摄的纪实感

terms.note: 增加真实感，与过度精致的画面相斥
terms.example: handheld documentary framing, old library with tall bookshelves

terms.name: 柔和窗光

flux_flux2.text: Soft light from a window falls gently across the subject
flux_flux2.text_zh: 来自窗户的柔光轻轻落在主体身上

terms.note: 最稳妥的人像光线，阴影过渡自然
terms.example: soft window light, portrait of a woman

terms.name: 黄金时刻

flux_flux2.text: Warm golden hour sunlight washes over the scene
flux_flux2.text_zh: 温暖的黄金时刻阳光洒满整个场景

terms.note: 日落前后的暖调低角度光，与夜景互斥
terms.example: golden hour sunlight, desert dunes at dusk

terms.name: 轮廓光

flux_flux2.text: A soft rim of light traces the edge of the subject

terms.name: 逆光

flux_flux2.text_zh: 主体处于逆光之中，边缘在光里发亮

terms.name: 霓虹光

terms.name: 冷月光

terms.name: 烛光

flux_flux2.text_zh: 温暖的烛光在主体附近轻轻摇曳

terms.example: warm candlelight, old library with tall bookshelves

flux_flux2.text_zh: 整张画面的配色温暖而有亲近感

terms.note: 统一画面色温，与冷色调互斥

terms.name: 冷色调

flux_flux2.text_zh: 整张画面的配色清冷而克制

flux_flux2.text_zh: 整个画面以纯黑白呈现

terms.name: 柔和粉彩

flux_flux2.text_zh: 柔和的粉彩色让画面显得温柔

terms.note: 日系与插画的经典配色

terms.name: 大地色

flux_flux2.text_zh: 低饱和的大地色让配色自然而不张扬

flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面色彩浓郁饱和，冲击力很强

terms.name: 双色调

flux_flux2.text_zh: 双色调配色把画面收敛成两种颜色

terms.example: duotone color scheme, bold headline text

flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面色彩被调成经典胶片的质感

terms.name: 互补色对比
terms.text_zh: 互补色形成的色彩对比

flux_flux2.text_zh: 互补色在画面中形成强烈的视觉对比

terms.note: 让主体在背景中跳出来的配色策略

terms.name: 写实摄影

flux_flux2.text: The image looks like a real photograph
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面看起来就是一张真实的照片

terms.note: 默认写实路线，与动漫插画风格互斥
terms.example: photorealistic, detailed skin texture, 85mm portrait lens

terms.name: 动漫插画

flux_flux2.text: The image is drawn in a clean anime illustration style
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面以干净的动漫插画风格绘制

terms.note: 二次元路线，与写实摄影互斥
terms.example: anime illustration style, a young girl, soft pastel palette

terms.name: 油画
terms.text: oil painting style with visible brushstrokes

flux_flux2.text: The image is painted like an oil painting with visible brushstrokes
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面像油画一样绘制，笔触清晰可见

terms.name: 水彩

flux_flux2.text: Soft watercolor washes define the whole image
flux_flux2.text_zh: 柔和的水彩晕染构成整个画面

terms.note: 通透轻盈，边缘自然晕开
terms.example: watercolor painting, misty forest at dawn

terms.name: 赛博朋克

flux_flux2.text: The image follows a cyberpunk aesthetic of neon light and rain
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面遵循霓虹与雨夜交织的赛博朋克美学

terms.note: 高科技低生活，霓虹与机械并存
terms.example: cyberpunk aesthetic, narrow neon-lit alley

terms.name: 极简主义

flux_flux2.text: The image follows a minimalist style with very few elements
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面走极简路线，只保留极少的元素

terms.note: 大量留白与少量元素，与繁复细节互斥
terms.example: minimalist style, generous negative space

terms.name: 水墨

flux_flux2.text: The image is rendered as a Chinese ink wash painting
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面以中国水墨画的方式呈现

terms.note: 留白与墨韵，适合山水与东方题材
terms.example: chinese ink wash painting, windswept mountain ridge

terms.name: 像素艺术

flux_flux2.text: The image is created as pixel art
flux_flux2.text_zh: 整张图以像素艺术的形式创作

terms.note: 复古游戏质感，与写实路线强烈冲突
terms.example: pixel art, a humanoid robot

terms.name: 复古胶片

flux_flux2.text: The image carries the look of old vintage film
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面带有老式复古胶片的样子

terms.note: 颗粒、褪色与柔焦，常配怀旧氛围
terms.example: vintage film look, nostalgic atmosphere

terms.name: 概念设计

flux_flux2.text: The image looks like professional concept art
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面看起来像专业的概念设计稿

terms.note: 影视与游戏前期设定稿风格
terms.example: concept art style, futuristic city skyline

terms.name: 宁静

flux_flux2.text: The atmosphere feels peaceful and calm
flux_flux2.text_zh: 整个氛围宁静而平和

terms.note: 低冲突情绪，适合风景与日常
terms.example: peaceful and calm atmosphere, misty forest at dawn

terms.name: 孤寂

flux_flux2.text: The scene feels lonely and solitary
flux_flux2.text_zh: 场景显得孤独而冷清

terms.note: 空旷环境与单一主体共同构成
terms.example: lonely solitary atmosphere, open snow field

terms.name: 梦幻空灵

flux_flux2.text: A dreamy, ethereal mood softens the whole scene
flux_flux2.text_zh: 梦幻空灵的情绪把整个场景柔化

terms.note: 柔焦与散射光共同营造
terms.example: dreamy ethereal atmosphere, volumetric light rays

terms.name: 紧张悬疑

flux_flux2.text: The atmosphere is tense and full of suspense
flux_flux2.text_zh: 氛围紧张，充满悬疑感

terms.note: 高对比光与倾斜构图强化不安
terms.example: tense suspenseful atmosphere, dutch angle composition

terms.name: 温暖治愈

flux_flux2.text: The mood is cozy and comforting
flux_flux2.text_zh: 整体氛围温暖而治愈

terms.note: 暖色与柔和光线共同作用
terms.example: cozy and comforting atmosphere, warm candlelight

terms.name: 史诗壮丽

flux_flux2.text: The scene carries an epic sense of scale
flux_flux2.text_zh: 整个场景带有史诗般的尺度感

terms.note: 大场景广角，主体在环境中显得渺小
terms.example: epic grand atmosphere, windswept mountain ridge

terms.name: 神秘

flux_flux2.text: A mysterious mood hangs over the scene
flux_flux2.text_zh: 神秘的情绪笼罩着整个场景

terms.note: 遮挡、雾气与局部光共同构建
terms.example: mysterious atmosphere, volumetric light rays

terms.name: 怀旧

flux_flux2.text: The image carries a nostalgic feeling
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面带着一种怀旧的情绪

terms.note: 与复古胶片、老场景天然契合
terms.example: nostalgic atmosphere, old library with tall bookshelves

terms.name: 活力动感

flux_flux2.text: The mood is energetic and full of movement
flux_flux2.text_zh: 整体氛围充满活力与动势

terms.note: 运动与高饱和色彩的叠加效果
terms.example: energetic dynamic atmosphere, running at full speed

terms.name: 静谧夜色

flux_flux2.text: The night feels serene and completely still
flux_flux2.text_zh: 夜晚宁静得完全没有一丝声响

terms.note: 夜景但不喧嚣，与霓虹的热闹相对
terms.example: serene night atmosphere, cold moonlight

terms.name: 锐利对焦

flux_flux2.text: The subject is rendered in sharp, precise focus
flux_flux2.text_zh: 主体被锐利而精准地合焦

terms.note: 最基础的质量要求，几乎无副作用
terms.example: sharp focus, portrait of a woman

terms.name: 丰富细节

flux_flux2.text: The image is richly detailed throughout
flux_flux2.text_zh: 整张图从头到尾都充满细节

terms.note: 通用质量词，与极简风格互斥
terms.example: highly detailed, brushed metal surface

terms.name: 精细纹理

flux_flux2.text: Fine textures are resolved with great clarity
flux_flux2.text_zh: 细微的纹理被清晰地还原出来

terms.note: 材质表现的加分描述
terms.example: fine texture detail, worn leather texture

terms.name: 干净渲染

flux_flux2.text: The render is clean and free of distracting artifacts
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面渲染干净，没有干扰视线的伪影

terms.note: 抑制结构崩坏与噪点的通用描述
terms.example: clean rendering, product photography

terms.name: 专业调色

flux_flux2.text: The image is finished with professional color grading
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面经过专业级的调色处理

terms.note: 后期完成度要求，商业稿常用
terms.example: professional color grading, teal and orange color grading

terms.name: 获奖级摄影

flux_flux2.text: The photograph looks like an award-winning shot
flux_flux2.text_zh: 这张照片看起来像获奖作品

terms.note: 整体完成度诉求，写实风格效果最好
terms.example: award-winning photography, golden hour sunlight

terms.name: 均衡曝光

flux_flux2.text: The exposure is balanced, keeping detail in both highlights and shadows
flux_flux2.text_zh: 曝光均衡，高光和阴影都保留了细节

terms.note: 避免过曝与死黑，大光比场景必备
terms.example: well balanced exposure, backlit with glowing edges

terms.name: 清晰边缘

flux_flux2.text: Every edge stays crisp and clean
flux_flux2.text_zh: 所有边缘都保持干练清晰

terms.note: 抑制糊边与结构粘连
terms.example: crisp clean edges, glazed ceramic surface

terms.name: 层次分明

flux_flux2.text: The image shows clear separation between depth layers
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面各景深层之间分离得很清楚

terms.note: 与构图层次配合，提升空间感
terms.example: clear depth layering, layered foreground midground and background

terms.name: 精良构图

flux_flux2.text: The frame is composed with care and clear intention
flux_flux2.text_zh: 画面构图经过仔细考量，意图明确

terms.note: 对整体安排的完成度要求
terms.example: well composed frame, rule of thirds composition

terms.name: 醒目主标题

flux_flux2.text: A bold headline sits clearly at the top of the design
flux_flux2.text_zh: 醒目的大标题清晰地位于设计顶部

terms.note: 仅在用户明确要求文字时补充，避免凭空生成文字
terms.example: bold headline text, poster style layout

terms.name: 极简无衬线

flux_flux2.text: Minimal sans-serif typography keeps the text understated
flux_flux2.text_zh: 极简的无衬线字体让文字保持低调

terms.note: 现代、克制，科技品牌常用
terms.example: minimal sans-serif typography, generous negative space

terms.name: 优雅衬线

flux_flux2.text: Elegant serif typography gives the text a refined look
flux_flux2.text_zh: 优雅的衬线字体让文字显得精致

terms.note: 高端、经典，适合电影海报
terms.example: elegant serif typography, centered text block

terms.name: 霓虹灯字

flux_flux2.text: The text glows like a neon sign
flux_flux2.text_zh: 文字像霓虹灯招牌一样发光

terms.note: 夜景与赛博朋克场景的文字表现
terms.example: neon sign lettering, narrow neon-lit alley

terms.name: 海报版式

flux_flux2.text: The text is arranged in a clear poster layout
flux_flux2.text_zh: 文字按照清晰的海报版式排布

terms.note: 强调整体版式而不只是单个字
terms.example: poster style layout, duotone color scheme

terms.name: 手写标题

flux_flux2.text: The title is written in a natural handwritten style
flux_flux2.text_zh: 标题用自然的手写风格写成

terms.note: 人情味与手作感，注意文字可读性
terms.example: handwritten title, a handmade dish

terms.name: 居中文字块

flux_flux2.text: A centered block of text anchors the composition
flux_flux2.text_zh: 居中的文字块稳住了整个构图

terms.note: 稳定庄重，适合正式海报
terms.example: centered text block, centered symmetrical composition

terms.name: 网格排版

flux_flux2.text: The text follows a strict grid layout
flux_flux2.text_zh: 文字严格遵循网格排版

terms.note: 瑞士风格，秩序感强
terms.example: grid based text layout, minimalist style

terms.name: 竖排文字

flux_flux2.text: The text is arranged vertically down the design
flux_flux2.text_zh: 文字自上而下竖排排列

terms.note: 东方语境常用，与水墨、国风契合
terms.example: vertical text arrangement, chinese ink wash painting

terms.name: 立体浮雕字

flux_flux2.text: The lettering is embossed and catches light like a real 3D surface
flux_flux2.text_zh: 文字做成立体浮雕，像真实 3D 表面一样反光

terms.note: 需要明确的侧光才能体现体积
terms.example: embossed 3d lettering, hard light with strong shadows

terms.name: 模糊低清
terms.note: 最基础的质量排除项
terms.example: blurry, low resolution, jpeg artifacts

terms.name: 多余手指
terms.note: 人物生成最常见缺陷，几乎必带
terms.example: extra fingers, deformed hands, bad anatomy

terms.name: 结构畸形
terms.note: 整体结构约束，与肢体排除项互补
terms.example: bad anatomy, distorted body, duplicate limbs

terms.name: 水印与多余文字
terms.note: 避免模型凭空生成乱码文字
terms.example: watermark, signature, unwanted text

terms.name: 过饱和
terms.note: 抑制颜色溢出，写实时常用
terms.example: oversaturated colors, harsh contrast

terms.name: 压缩伪影
terms.note: 提升画面纯净度
terms.example: jpeg artifacts, noise, blurry

terms.name: 面部扭曲
terms.note: 人像必带的面部约束
terms.example: distorted face, asymmetric eyes, bad anatomy

terms.name: 背景杂乱
terms.note: 产品与极简构图的有效约束
terms.example: cluttered background, messy details

terms.name: 过曝死白
terms.note: 逆光与雪景场景应加入
terms.example: overexposed, blown highlights, washed out

terms.name: 重复肢体
terms.text_zh: 重复的肢体与多余的手臂
terms.note: 全身人像的高频缺陷
terms.example: duplicate limbs, extra arms, extra legs
